name: looping dot menu

files.index.html: Standalone current human test, seven real named links and accessible trigger.

files.menu.js: createLoopMenu(root), returning destroy(); pointer/wheel/keyboard controller with responsive and reduced-motion lifecycle.
files.motion.js: Pure infinite cyclic position, exponential flick decay and velocity-continuous critically damped alignment.
files.requirements.json: Requested behavior, integration decisions and verification limits.

integration: Load menu.css, use .loop-nav/.loop-toggle/.loop-panel/.loop-link markup from index.html, and load menu.js as a module. No external JavaScript, fonts or image dependencies. Seven existing source-site hrefs retained; replace with project destinations when supplied.
mobile: Narrow viewports <=767px, or hover:none + pointer:coarse + height<=600px: retain the mobile looping menu, including landscape phones wider than767px. Large fine-pointer desktops retain vertical navigation. Geometry/gestures unchanged.
desktop: Existing fixed vertical source-style dots retained; mobile interaction is the requested scope.
motion: Drag follows pointer, release decelerates into aligned row. Wheel/trackpad deltas are smoothed and gently aligned without injecting a second inertial tail. New input interrupts motion immediately; wrapping occurs outside clipped window.
accessibility: Native links/button/region; only centered link in tab order; ArrowUp/Down cycle following visual direction; Home/End; Enter; Escape returns focus to trigger. Resizing moves focus out of newly hidden content. Reduced-motion avoids coast and alignment animation. Pinch zoom allowed in touch region.
